items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: Joe Marius told my sister that he has never seen any family as crazy about their relatives as we are.

ctx.x: Well, your family, that's one thing I noticed yesterday. We were at the concert and families are very affectionate, you know. People, the Creole families, you know, they hug and kiss each other and they're always glad to see each other. And people always shaking hands and touching each other.

It's been a trade. It's always been a trade of the Creole people to hug and kiss each other whenever we met. And like Joe Marius told my sister that he has never seen any family as crazy about their relatives as we are. Because my sister sold over 200 and some tickets.
Oh, I can't believe that. She told me she sold over 100 when I was talking to her trying to get that.
